display.text:
autoload :Internet, "jekyll/utils/internet"
    autoload :Platforms, "jekyll/utils/platforms"
    autoload :ThreadEvent, "jekyll/utils/thread_event"
    autoload :WinTZ, "jekyll/utils/win_tz"

    # Constants for use in #slugify
    SLUGIFY_MODES = %w(raw default pretty ascii latin).freeze
    SLUGIFY_RAW_REGEXP = Regexp.new('\\s+').freeze
    SLUGIFY_DEFAULT_REGEXP = Regexp.new("[^[:alnum:]]+").freeze
    SLUGIFY_PRETTY_REGEXP = Regexp.new("[^[:alnum:]._~!$&'()+,;=@]+").freeze
    SLUGIFY_ASCII_REGEXP = Regexp.new("[^[A-Za-z0-9]]+").freeze

    # Takes a slug and turns it into a simple title.
    def titleize_slug(slug)
      @slug_work_cache ||= {}
      @slug_work_cache[:title_separator] ||= TITLE_SEPARATOR
      @slug_work_cache[:title_space] ||= TITLE_SPACE
      parts = slug.split(@slug_work_cache[:title_separator])
      capitalized = parts.map(&:capitalize)
      capitalized.join(@slug_work_cache[:title_space])
    end
    FLOAT_LIKE = %r!\A\s*-?(?:\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)\s*\Z!.freeze
    INTEGER_LIKE = %r!\A\s*-?\d+\s*\Z!.freeze
    SPECIAL_LEADING_CHAR_REGEX = %r!\A#{Regexp.union([".", "_", "#", "~"])}!o.freeze
    SAFE_URL_PATH_REGEXP = %r!^[a-zA-Z0-9./-]+$!.freeze
    YAML_HEADER_REGEXP = %r!\A---\s*\r?\n!.freeze
    SLUG_EDGE_HYPHEN_REGEXP = %r!^\-|\-$!i.freeze
    INDEX_PATH_REGEXP = %r!/index\.html?$!.freeze
    LIQUID_TAG_TOKEN = "{%".freeze
    LIQUID_OUTPUT_TOKEN = "{{".freeze
